entries.a19c668bdd06006c: The company is a comprehensive manufacturer of crystal devices, headquartered in Kakogawa, Hyogo Prefecture, which forms a group with 13 consolidated subsidiaries. It is a stand-alone operating company that manufactures and sells electronic components from materials such as synthetic crystal.
entries.ab3c5e8471e58bfb: Equipment manufacturers in the consumer field
entries.ae0d550ee2f30ed5: Based on its corporate creed of “Trust,” it has set a 10-year long-term management plan, the “OCEAN+2 Strategy,” and since April 2024 has been advancing the “Second Medium-Term Management Plan: Establishing a Foundation” (fiscal years ended March 2025 to March 2027). It positions the “Arkh Concept,” based on its in-house original “Arkh series” products born from advanced crystal growth and processing technology, as its most important management strategy, and is advancing full-scale mass production of the Arkh series, expansion of its product lineup, and industry standardization through supplying built-in crystal resonators to competitors.
entries.b37953f08ee118e5: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 2.4% year on year to ¥39,551 million. The analysis of operating results explains that, while demand declined in the communications and consumer fields due to the impact of a sharp rise in memory semiconductor prices, the automotive field remained firm and the industrial field shifted to a gradual recovery trend. It is also noted that the company focused on strengthening production capacity for crystal oscillators and high-frequency products, and on expanding sales of the Arkh series.

entries.ba8c6addf951b740: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥39,551 million. By location, China accounted for ¥12,928 million, Taiwan ¥9,277 million, and Japan ¥7,427 million.

entries.e000b67eb587513e: It manufactures and sells general-purpose crystal resonators, tuning-fork crystal resonators, crystal application products and others. In addition to manufacturing and selling these products itself, the company entrusts manufacturing to consolidated manufacturing subsidiaries in Japan and overseas.
entries.e164127500937c8a: Revenue from external customers by location was ¥12,928 million in China, ¥9,277 million in Taiwan, ¥7,427 million in Japan, ¥4,348 million in Europe, ¥2,868 million in Asia and ¥2,701 million in North America, with overseas regions accounting for a large share. It is noted that the crystal device market is expected to grow further due to expanding demand from digitalization, while in the crystal industry, competition has intensified with the rise of overseas manufacturers, such as those in China and Taiwan, in addition to competition with Japanese companies. The filing states that there is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.

entries.f9abc8009dbde164: The Arkh series is a product that adopts photolithography and wafer-level packaging technologies, which are also used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, and eliminates the need for externally sourced components such as ceramic packages and for conductive adhesives. It is described as achieving high productivity through batch processing at the wafer level, and the enlargement of synthetic crystal, larger-format crystal wafers, and cutting and polishing technologies are cited as the foundation of its competitiveness.
entries.fa2b002988226128: This is the crystal products business in Europe. DAISHINKU (DEUTSCHLAND) GmbH is responsible for sales of the company's products in the European region. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,348 million.
